m: शनैश्—चर mfn. walking or moving slowly, Bhartṛ.
शनैश्—चर m. the planet Saturn or its regent (cf. शनि), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (in MBh. also applied to other planets and even the sun)

k.v: रौहिणेयो बुधः सौम्यः समौ सौरिशनैश्चरौ। तमस्तु राहुः स्वर्भानुः सैंहिकेयो विधुन्तुदः॥

m: शनैश्—चर—कवच m. n. N. of wk.
शनैश्—चर—संवत्सर m. the year of Saturn (during which this planet completes his course through the 28 Nakṣatras; in modern astron. = 30 of our years), MW.
शनैर्—भाव m. slowness, graduality (ibc. before a pr. p. = slowly, by degrees), Kathās.
शनैर्—गङ्गम् ind. where the Gaṅgā flows slowly, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 21, Sch.
शनैर्—मेह m. slow or painful discharge of water from the bladder, dysuria, ŚārṅgS.
शनैर्—मे˚हिन् mfn. suffering from dysuria, Suśr.

m: शनैस् शनैस् (RV.) or शनैस् (ŚBr.) ind. (originally instr. pl. of शन, q.v.; cf. उच्चैस्, नीचैस्) quietly, softly, gently, gradually, alternately, RV.; &c.
a: शनैस् — ind. 1 Slowly, gently, quietly. --2 Gradually, by degrees, little by little; धर्मं संचिनुय च्छनैः; Ku. 3. 59; Ms. 3. 217. --3 Successively, in due order, Ms. 1. 15. --4 Mildly, softly. --5 Tardily, sluggishly. --6 Independently. (शनैः शनैः slowly, by slow degrees). --Comp. --चर a. going or moving slowly; शनैश्वराब्यां पादाब्यां रेजे ग्रहमयीव सा Bh. 1. 17. (where it means ‘Saturn’ also). --रः the planet Saturn.

k.v: अल्पे नीचैर्महत्युच्चैः प्रायो भूम्न्यद्रुते शनैः। सना नित्ये बहिर्बाह्ये स्मातीतेऽस्तमदर्शने॥

m: शनैस्—तराम् ind. more (or very) quietly, softly &c., AitBr.; ĀśvŚr.
शन (prob. connected with √ शम्), quiet, calm, soft (only in instr. pl. शनैस्, q.v.)

m: शनकावलि or शनकाव˚ली, f. (perhaps for शणक्˚; cf. शण) Scindapsus Officinalis, L.
शनकैश्-चर m. (fr. next + चर) = शनैश्चर, MW.
शनकैस् ind. (dimin. of शनैस्) quietly, softly, gently, by degrees, in every case that arises, with alternations, alternately, RV.; &c.
शनक m. (cf. शणक) N. of a son of Śambara, Hariv. (v.l. सेनक).

v: pu॰ SA--ani kicca । 1 sUryyaputre CAyAgarBajAte grahaBede “SanirvihaNgo'nilavanyavanDyA SUdrANganA DAtuHsamosTiraSca । kruraH pratIcItuvaro'tivfdDo'karaH kzitIw dIrGasunIlalOham” । nIla॰ tAja॰ । “mando'lasaH kapilakuntaladIrGagAtraH sTUladvijaH paruzaromakaconilAtmA” vfhajjA॰ । 2 tatsvAmikadine ca “SanO banDyAM vijAnIyAt” jyo॰ ta॰ ।
m: शनि m. (prob. ‘slow-moving’; cf. मन्द) the planet Saturn or its regent (fabled as the offspring of the Sun; he is represented as of a black colour or dressed in dark-coloured clothes; cf. नील-वासस्), R.; VarBṛS. &c.
of a son of Atri, VāyuP.
a: शनिः — [शो-अनि किच्च Tv.] 1 The planet Saturn (the son of the sun and represented as of a black colour or dressed in dark-coloured clothes). --2 Saturday. --3 N. of Śiva. --Comp. --जं black pepper. --प्रदोषः a term for the (evening) worship of Śiva performed on the thirteenth day of a lunar fortnight when it falls on a Saturday. --प्रसूः f. an epithet of Chāyā, wife of the sun; cf. संज्ञा. --प्रियं a sapphire. --वारः, --वासरः Saturday.

s: klI, (SaneScakram .) nfRAM SuBASuBajYAnArTaSaniBogyanakzatrAdisaptaviMSatinakzatrayuktanarAkAracakram । yaTA, -- “SanicakraM narAkAraM liKitvA sOriBAditaH । nAma fkzaM Bavedyatra PalaM tatra SuBASuBam ॥ ekaM muKe dakzahaste catvAri zaw padadbaye । hfdi paYca kare vAme catvAri mastake trayam ॥ dvayaM netradbaye guhye dvayaM tatra nyasedbuDaH । muKe hAnirjayo dakze BramaH pAde Sriyo hfdi । vAme BIrmastake rAjyaM netre sOKyaM mftirgude ॥ tUryyAzwadbAdaSe fkze yadA viGnakaraH SaniH । tadA sOKyaM vapuHsTantu hfcCIrze netradakzayoH ॥ tftIyEkAdaSe zazWe yadA sOKyakaraH SaniH । tadA viGnaH SarIrasTo guhye vaktre'NGrivAmayoH ॥ yasya pIqAkaraH SOristasya cakre Palantvidam । liKitvA kfzRadravyeRa tElamaDye kzipettataH ॥ nikzipya BUmimaDyasTaM kfzRapuzpEH prapUjayet । tuzwiM yAti na sandehaH pIqAM tyaktvA SanEScaraH ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥
m: शनि—चक्र n. Saturn's diagram (a peculiar diagram used to foretell good or bad fortune; it is marked with 27 compartments to represent the Nakṣatras passed through by the planet Saturn), MW.
शनि—प्रदोष m. ‘Saturn-evening’, N. of the worship performed to Śiva on the 13th day of the waxing or waning moon when it falls on a Saturday, MW.

s: strI, (SaneH prasUrjananI .) CAyA । sUryyapatnI । iti BUriprayogaH ॥
m: शनि—प्रसू f. ‘mother of S˚’, N. of Chāyā (wife of the Sun), L.
शनि—प्रिय n. ‘dear to S˚’, a dark-coloured stone (the emerald or sapphire), L.
